description: The confirmed fouls in one fighter's UFC bouts since December 2018, both the ones the fighter committed and the ones committed against them: eye pokes and low blows from the official in-fight log, plus any other foul (an illegal knee to a grounded opponent, an upkick, a headbutt, a bite, a fence grab) confirmed by the athletic commission's point deduction or by the official result. Returns the counts by kind, the points deducted, the time bouts were stopped for them, fouls per 15 minutes, and every incident with the event, opponent, round and time, the foul, the record that confirms it (log, deduction or result), the points deducted and whether the bout ended on it. A stoppage with no record behind it is never counted. A recorded foul is not a ruling on intent. Pro plans and up.
name: get_fighter_discipline
title: Get a fighter's discipline record
